editorial.blurb: Peanut Park Trattoria serves generous, craveable Italian fare in a cozy Little Italy spot where the staff makes you feel like family.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask the staff about parking assistance, order the full-size chicken parm only if you're truly hungry (portions are massive), and don't skip the bread with whipped ricotta—it's a sleeper hit.

topDishes.note: Huge, excellent portions that reviewers rave about
